source: Official NHL Stats REST skater summary, individual regular-season games, all players, monthly partitions
features: Existing ten opportunityFeatures; same-season, same-team, at least three prior appearances and unchanged role checks; no target-game workload
alternatives: legacy frozen workload-rate ridge plus rounded pooled residuals
legacy mean with Poisson likelihood (previous CW08 candidate)
expanded Poisson GLM, standardized features, alpha=1.0
expanded Poisson GLM plus negative-binomial dispersion fitted on calibration only
expanded hurdle: logistic any-event probability plus zero-truncated Poisson positive count, L2 C=1, alpha=1.0
calibration: One nonnegative multiplicative mean factor for Poisson/NB; one intercept correction for hurdle event probability, on calibration only
evaluation: full-count negative log likelihood for count candidates
primary: 0.5-line Brier, both NHL markets separately, with fixture-cluster uncertainty
independence: Report all eligible players and separately exclude the ten original cohort players. Confirmation period is later than every fitting, calibration and evaluation period.
selection: No OVER/UNDER balancing. No model selection or hyperparameter tuning on test/confirmation results. No odds-dependent bet or profit claim without archived exact pregame quotes.
approval: No production promotion in this experiment. Require noninferiority versus legacy on independent time windows, count calibration, exact-price validation, prospective frozen capture, and application regressions. Preserve all original picks.
